intro: Two readers look at every image: ResNet-18 and Gemini Decision 1.
The conditions below are checked strictly from top to bottom.
The first one that matches decides the final Tier.

terms.text: The probability, according to Gemini, that the image is a chest X-ray. The minimum is scope_min (50%).
Gemini's technical rating of the image: High, Noisy or Unacceptable. Currently quality_blocks = False, so poor quality only lowers the Tier from A to B and does not stop the analysis.
The calibrated confidence ResNet-18 needs for its answer to count as reliable (computed on validation for at most 10% error).
The minimum Gemini confidence in its diagnosis (default 80%).
A special, higher ResNet-18 threshold for COVID-19 (computed for at least 90% precision; default 85%).

tiers.title: Not a chest X-ray or quality fails gate
tiers.condition: Scope < 50% (does not look like a chest X-ray), or Quality is Unacceptable with at least 70% confidence when quality_blocks = True.
shows: The analysis stops (NO READING). The system refuses to give a diagnosis and asks for a new image.

tiers.title: Gemini unavailable
tiers.condition: Gemini is unavailable (error, timeout or missing API key).
shows: Provisional result from one model only. A "Scope not verified" banner appears because nobody checked that the image is an X-ray.

tiers.title: Both readers agree and both exceed thresholds
tiers.condition: Both models agree AND ResNet ≥ t_res AND Gemini ≥ t_gem AND Quality is High.
shows: Highest certainty. Full agreement between both models with no remarks.

tiers.title: Both readers agree, but one or both are weak
tiers.condition: Both models agree, but with at least one remark: ResNet < t_res, OR Gemini < t_gem, OR Quality is not High.
shows: Agreement with a warning. The result is valid, and a "Caution:" text gives the exact reason (for example a noisy image or low confidence).

tiers.title: COVID override
tiers.condition: The models disagree, but covid_override = True, ResNet says COVID-19 AND its confidence is ≥ t_covid.
shows: Special priority for COVID-19. Trust goes to ResNet-18, but confirmation by a physician is required.

tiers.title: Readers disagree or etiologic suspicion is mixed
tiers.condition: The models disagree and do not fall into Tier C.
shows: URGENT REVIEW: both suspect disease, but different diseases (for example Pneumonia vs COVID-19).
REVIEW: one says NORMAL, the other suspects disease.
